name: Data table
looksLike: information lined up in rows and columns
spreadsheet-like list with headings above each column
names dates and amounts arranged in a grid
definition: A structured view of records in rows and fields in columns, with headers explaining how to read the values.

notConfusedWith.difference: Arranges content tiles for emphasis rather than aligning fields across records.

prompts.short: Add a data table with a descriptive caption and associated column headers.
prompts.detailed: Add a semantic table with a caption, column headers, and row headers where helpful. Keep cell relationships intact on small screens. If horizontal scrolling is necessary, provide a labeled keyboard-focusable scroll region. If sorting is added, use header buttons and expose the sorted column with aria-sort.

html: <div role="region" aria-label="Recent orders table" tabindex="0" style="max-width:100%; overflow:auto">

a11yNotes: Use table, caption, and scoped header cells
Keep overflow regions keyboard accessible with visible focus
Use real buttons and aria-sort if sorting is implemented
